faq.q: What is the origin of Suhail?
faq.a: Suhail is associated with Arabic. Suhail is Arabic سُهَيْل (Suhayl), the name of the star Canopus.
Yes — the underlying form سُهَيْل is Arabic.
Suhail can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
